items.title: Komi-san wa Komyushou Desu.
items.synopsis:
Komi-san is a beautiful and admirable girl that no one can take their eyes off of. Almost the whole school sees her as the cold beauty that's out of their league, but Tadano Hitohito knows the truth: she's just really bad at communicating with others.

Komi-san, who wishes to fix this bad habit of hers, tries to improve it with the help of Tadano-kun by achieving her goal of having 100 friends.

---

items.title: Can't Forget
items.synopsis:
Ji-An and Han Jeong-Won, best friends since their school days. The two naturally developed into lovers as adults, but Ji-An realizes at some point that the future she thought would always be happy is not the girl she knows...

items.title: The Gamer with Social Anxiety is the Strongest in Solo Play
items.synopsis: [Loner who can't communicate becomes the strongest player!] Kiyoshirou, a loner with no friends at school, has a hobby: the VR game "Central Sword". But one day, the game suddenly becomes reality, and a "gate" appears over Japan! Kiyoshirou will have to challenge himself to a life-threatening battle, in a world where cities all over Japan have been turned into dungeons! He will use his vast knowledge and weaponry, conquer one beast after another, and become known as the 'invincible player'. However, he has a fatal weakness... "I can't team up with anyone because I can't communicate!". What answers will Kiyoshirou find as he treads along the path of solo play to become the strongest player? -- A story of the strongest loner in a world where he can't afford to make a mistake!

items.title: Commushou Senpai to no SEX Simulation
items.synopsis:
